fields.summary_ko.0: V rose 26.1% over past 12 months, outpacing S&P 500's 13.7%, with management citing Q2 FY2027 as lowest growth quarter.
fields.summary_ko.1: Approximately 25% of FY2027 payment volumes are up for renewal (vs. 20% in FY2026); customer incentives increased 21% in FY2026 Q4.
fields.summary_ko.2: Value-added services represent $1.4 billion of FY2026 net revenue of $4.6 billion, with FY2027 growth projected at 20–25% (decelerating from FY2026's 30%).
